lines.zh: 我四条腿包在木板里走。
lines.en: I walk on four legs wrapped in boards.

lines.zh: 箱子一开一合，就当是腿。
lines.en: My chest opens and shuts; that's how I walk.
I crush a swath of vines.
I shift along the ground, heavy.

lines.zh: 锁扣响了一下，那是关节。
lines.en: A latch clicks. That's a joint.
I squeeze between the roots.
I cross fallen leaves with a dull sound.
My teeth show under the lid.

lines.zh: 我挪到路边，装成落单的箱子。
lines.en: I shuffle to the path and pose as a stray chest.

lines.zh: 我每一步都带着木头的吱呀。
lines.en: Every step creaks with wood.
I push the stones out of my path.
I turn, and the vines all snap.
I stop, my lid slightly ajar.
I pretend to be a chest, perfectly still.
Vines grow out of my seams.
I've waited longer than I can recall.
There's a brass lock on my wood.

lines.zh: 我在数落叶上的脚步声。
lines.en: I count footsteps on the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我箱底还有旧的金币印。
lines.en: Old coin marks remain on my base.
I open and close as if breathing.
I know this jungle.
I keep my teeth hidden.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我看见你的脖子。
lines.en: You crouch, and I see your neck.
You want to open me?
I'm not a chest. I'm a mouth.
Standing that close makes it easy.
The lock on me is a lie.
Bend a little more.
I wait for your fingers to touch the lid.

lines.zh: 这套把戏我用过很多回。
lines.en: I've used this trick many times.
There's greed in your eyes.
Your fingertip touches my latch.
A board of mine splits.
My lid won't close right.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，藤断了几根。
lines.en: I retreat; a few vines snap.
That got into a seam.
Everything inside rattles.
My lock is bent.
I can still stand.

lines.zh: 箱底那层板，被你敲穿了。
lines.en: You've punched through the board at my base.
I shudder and sawdust falls.
I'll remember those hands.
You're handing it over. Perfect.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我连看都不看。
lines.en: I don't even look at what you offer.

lines.zh: 借着这个，你靠得更近了。
lines.en: It brings you closer.
You set it down and bent over.
That bait is worth less than you.

lines.zh: 我不为食物动，我为人动。
lines.en: I don't move for food. I move for people.
Take your time. Don't rush.
Half a foot closer will do.
This works. I like it.
You've come to me. I won't refuse.
You hit the corner of my chest.
The boards are hard. Now you know.
I don't move; you step back.
You've touched my lock.
My lid clacks against you.
Something rattles inside me.
You stepped on my vine.
That bump doesn't count as opening.
My corner knocks your knee.
Don't touch that seam.
Another chest hides in the vines.
We knock against each other.
Its boards are newer than mine.
We don't share prey.

lines.zh: 我们离得很远，谁也不碰谁。
lines.en: We keep apart, neither touching.
It shuts its lid first.

lines.zh: 我们都在等下一次有人来。
lines.en: We both wait for the next visitor.
This end of the jungle is mine.

lines.zh: 它的藤爬到我的范围内了。
lines.en: Its vines have crept into my range.

lines.zh: 两口箱子各自合上盖子。
lines.en: Both chests close their lids.
I swallow it into my chest.
I take what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 门一开一合，东西就进去了。
lines.en: My lid opens and shuts, and it's inside.
This pearl isn't worth much.
I press it under me.
The drops are all mine.
I drag it along.
Its smell mixes with the wood.
I shut my lid. Stowed.
No one will come asking for it.
You've finally bent to look.
I've opened a crack.
You can't escape this.
I've waited long for this moment.
Your fingers are still on the lid.
I've fixed on your hands.
My teeth are ready.

lines.zh: 你身后那截路，被我堵住了。
lines.en: I've blocked the path behind you.
This isn't a treasure chest.
I bring the whole chest down.
Vines have your feet.
Listen: the wood is creaking.
I heave myself up.
Your smell is fresh.
Come. One more step.
This bite is enough for you.
The lid swings open, all teeth inside.

lines.zh: 我的四个角都立起来了。
lines.en: All four of my corners are up.
Try to run; the chest will chase.
My four legs are quick.
I'm behind you. Very quiet.
The vines you broke give you away.
I keep my eyes on your back.
You change path; so does the chest.

lines.zh: 你绕的那棵树，挡不住我。
lines.en: That tree you circle can't hide you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在落叶上很响。
lines.en: Your steps are loud on the leaves.

lines.zh: 我不停，我的牙合不上就难受。
lines.en: I don't stop. My teeth ache to close.
You have a few steps left in you.

lines.zh: 你跑得越急，木箱跟得越紧。
lines.en: The harder you run, the closer the chest follows.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟离我的牙只差一尺。
lines.en: Your heel is a foot from my teeth.
A vine tripped you.

lines.zh: 我听得出你快喘不上气了。
lines.en: I can hear you running out of breath.
You won't clear that ravine.

lines.zh: 我就在你后面一箱之隔。
lines.en: I'm one chest-length behind.
You've backed into the open. Good.
I'm patient. I'll wait to close.
I've pinned your shadow.
One last step of retreat remains.

lines.zh: 盖子猛地合上，咬住你的手。
lines.en: The lid snaps shut on your hand.
Four corners slam your chest.
That one split the boards.

lines.zh: 盖子合上，咬住了你的腿。
lines.en: My lid snaps shut on your leg.
My teeth are denser than you'd think.
You pull your hand back, blood dripping.
I drive a corner into your knee.
You fall, and I press down.
The rattling inside grows louder.
That one was an old debt.
You blocked a corner, not the lid.
I ram you with the whole chest.
Vines coil your legs from behind.
Your torch falls from your hand.
I bite the rim of your shield.
I heave up from the side and slam you.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的护腕咬穿了。
lines.en: That bit through your bracer.
You retreat; my lid keeps snapping.

lines.zh: 我用整个箱子砸你的脚。
lines.en: I bring the whole chest down on your foot.
Pinned under me, you can't move.
One more chest among the vines.
I set myself in the middle of the path.

lines.zh: 我卡在两棵树之间，等你。
lines.en: I wedge myself between two trees and wait.
I shut my lid and wait.

lines.zh: 落叶堆里，我支起四个角。
lines.en: I push my four corners up out of the leaf litter.
The jungle smells strong.
I wind vines over myself.

lines.zh: 我摆出一个旧箱子的样子。
lines.en: I take the look of an old chest.
I settle in the tree's shade.
I hear someone cutting vines.
I tuck my teeth under the lid.
Plenty of people take this path.
Wood fears fire. I shut my lid fast.

lines.zh: 落地那下，箱子散了半边。
lines.en: On landing, half my chest comes apart.
Water seeps in and I sink.
The blast flips my lid open.
An arrow sticks in my lid and won't come out.
Light gets into the seam and burns.
It's been too long since I last fed.
Lightning strikes; the wood chars.
I fall with my lid still wide.
